{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Implement tenant-specific ZK metadata isolation through a configurable namespace, with the effective namespace applied consistently to all metadata paths and validated at startup.",
    "Collect Admin server credentials interactively through xd-shell or the relevant command-line client, avoid command-line password arguments, and prevent credentials from being persisted or written to logs.",
    "Use a dedicated maintenance branch derived from the current master/release baseline and document the branch and merge policy.",
    "Remove deprecated module-registry APIs and their callers, including obsolete download paths in Shell and Admin-UI where identified by compilation and test coverage.",
    "For random Admin server ports, use ZK-backed endpoint discovery as the initial design rather than introducing a load balancer; expose only the endpoint metadata required by xd-shell.",
    "Update Kafka integration for the rewritten consumer API while preserving existing message-bus behavior and test semantics.",
    "Treat U7 as a feasibility and design spike: define a Motion-JPEG stream format and ingestion boundary, but do not implement a complete facial-detection analytics pipeline.",
    "Add the cluster-view message-rate setting to servers.yml with a backward-compatible default and propagate it through configuration loading to the UI.",
    "Use existing project conventions, build tooling, test frameworks, logging facilities, and supported Java/runtime versions rather than introducing new infrastructure."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The existing repository, build, CI, ZK integration, Admin server, xd-shell, module registry, Kafka adapter, and cluster-view UI are available and buildable.",
    "One workday represents approximately eight hours of individual developer effort; estimates include coding, local investigation, unit tests, integration tests, and code review preparation, but not elapsed waiting time.",
    "The increment is implemented by one developer, with no parallel development effort or dedicated QA engineer.",
    "Existing APIs and configuration conventions are sufficiently documented through source code and tests; no extensive reverse engineering of external systems is required.",
    "U1 changes the namespace used for ZK metadata and does not require migration of existing tenant data beyond compatibility handling for the default namespace.",
    "U2 requires interactive authentication for Admin server access and does not include a new identity provider, password rotation system, or broad authentication redesign.",
    "U3 is a repository and release-management change; it does not require changes to the product runtime.",
    "U4 removes deprecated functionality only where current tests and compilation identify safe callers; unrelated legacy cleanup is out of scope.",
    "U5 requires discovery and use of an Admin endpoint registered in ZK, with existing ZK connectivity available to xd-shell; load-balancer implementation is out of scope.",
    "U6 assumes the Kafka broker and test environment can be upgraded or configured for the rewritten consumer API without redesigning the message-bus abstraction.",
    "U7 covers Motion-JPEG feasibility research, format design, and a limited ingestion prototype or validation harness; production-grade video analytics, OpenCV portability work, and facial-detection algorithms are out of scope.",
    "U8 requires one servers.yml configuration parameter and corresponding cluster-view behavior, with the current behavior retained by default.",
    "Documentation is limited to user/developer documentation needed to explain configuration, command usage, branch policy, and the U7 design findings."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Increment analysis and technical design",
      "activity_description": "Inspect the existing modules, build and test structure, ZK metadata paths, authentication flow, Admin endpoint registration, Kafka adapter, cluster-view configuration, and relevant UI/Shell code. Produce an implementation plan, identify cross-story impacts, and define acceptance-focused test cases.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Implement configurable tenant metadata namespace",
      "activity_description": "Add namespace configuration and validation, apply it to ZK metadata reads and writes, preserve the default behavior, update affected service and client code, and add unit and integration tests for default and tenant-specific namespaces.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "Implement interactive Admin server authentication",
      "activity_description": "Add username and password prompts to the Admin access flow, use a secure password-input mechanism, pass credentials only in memory, sanitize errors and logs, and add tests covering successful, failed, and omitted credential cases.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "Create and document maintenance branch",
      "activity_description": "Create the maintenance branch at the appropriate baseline, verify branch/build metadata, and document the intended minor-release workflow and relationship to master.",
      "most_likely_effort": 1.5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "Clean up deprecated module-registry functionality",
      "activity_description": "Locate deprecated module-registry APIs and callers, remove obsolete module-definition download functions, update Shell and Admin-UI references, resolve compilation impacts, and add or adjust regression tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "Discover random Admin port through xd-shell",
      "activity_description": "Complete the direct-ZK versus load-balancer investigation, define the endpoint metadata contract, register or expose the randomly assigned Admin port in ZK, implement xd-shell discovery and connection handling, and test startup, lookup failure, and reconnect scenarios.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "Update Kafka consumer integration and rerun tests",
      "activity_description": "Adapt the Kafka message-bus integration to the rewritten consumer API, update test fixtures and configuration as needed, rerun previously failing tests, diagnose regressions, and add compatibility coverage for consumption, offsets, and failure handling.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "Motion-JPEG ingestion feasibility spike and design",
      "activity_description": "Research Motion-JPEG framing and streaming requirements, assess platform-compatible implementation options, define the stream and frame-ingestion interfaces, build a small validation prototype or test harness, document risks and constraints, and provide design recommendations for later analytics integration.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "Add configurable cluster-view message rates",
      "activity_description": "Add the servers.yml parameter with a backward-compatible default, load and validate the setting, propagate it to cluster-view services and UI behavior, and add configuration and rendering tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Cross-module integration and regression testing",
      "activity_description": "Run the complete build and relevant integration suites across Core, Admin, Shell, Admin-UI, ZK, Kafka, and cluster-view changes; fix cross-story defects, verify backward compatibility, and perform a focused security review of credential and endpoint handling.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A11",
      "activity_name": "Documentation, packaging, and increment completion",
      "activity_description": "Update configuration references, Shell/Admin usage documentation, release and maintenance-branch notes, U7 spike findings, changelog information, and final build/package verification.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 53.5
  }
}

technical_and_design_decisions: Implement tenant-specific ZK metadata isolation through a configurable namespace, with the effective namespace applied consistently to all metadata paths and validated at startup.

Collect Admin server credentials interactively through xd-shell or the relevant command-line client, avoid command-line password arguments, and prevent credentials from being persisted or written to logs.
Use a dedicated maintenance branch derived from the current master/release baseline and document the branch and merge policy.
Remove deprecated module-registry APIs and their callers, including obsolete download paths in Shell and Admin-UI where identified by compilation and test coverage.
For random Admin server ports, use ZK-backed endpoint discovery as the initial design rather than introducing a load balancer; expose only the endpoint metadata required by xd-shell.
Update Kafka integration for the rewritten consumer API while preserving existing message-bus behavior and test semantics.
Treat U7 as a feasibility and design spike: define a Motion-JPEG stream format and ingestion boundary, but do not implement a complete facial-detection analytics pipeline.
Add the cluster-view message-rate setting to servers.yml with a backward-compatible default and propagate it through configuration loading to the UI.
Use existing project conventions, build tooling, test frameworks, logging facilities, and supported Java/runtime versions rather than introducing new infrastructure.
assumptions: The existing repository, build, CI, ZK integration, Admin server, xd-shell, module registry, Kafka adapter, and cluster-view UI are available and buildable.

One workday represents approximately eight hours of individual developer effort; estimates include coding, local investigation, unit tests, integration tests, and code review preparation, but not elapsed waiting time.
The increment is implemented by one developer, with no parallel development effort or dedicated QA engineer.
Existing APIs and configuration conventions are sufficiently documented through source code and tests; no extensive reverse engineering of external systems is required.
U1 changes the namespace used for ZK metadata and does not require migration of existing tenant data beyond compatibility handling for the default namespace.
U2 requires interactive authentication for Admin server access and does not include a new identity provider, password rotation system, or broad authentication redesign.
U3 is a repository and release-management change; it does not require changes to the product runtime.
U4 removes deprecated functionality only where current tests and compilation identify safe callers; unrelated legacy cleanup is out of scope.
U5 requires discovery and use of an Admin endpoint registered in ZK, with existing ZK connectivity available to xd-shell; load-balancer implementation is out of scope.
U6 assumes the Kafka broker and test environment can be upgraded or configured for the rewritten consumer API without redesigning the message-bus abstraction.

U7 covers Motion-JPEG feasibility research, format design, and a limited ingestion prototype or validation harness; production-grade video analytics, OpenCV portability work, and facial-detection algorithms are out of scope.
U8 requires one servers.yml configuration parameter and corresponding cluster-view behavior, with the current behavior retained by default.
Documentation is limited to user/developer documentation needed to explain configuration, command usage, branch policy, and the U7 design findings.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing modules, build and test structure, ZK metadata paths, authentication flow, Admin endpoint registration, Kafka adapter, cluster-view configuration, and relevant UI/Shell code. Produce an implementation plan, identify cross-story impacts, and define acceptance-focused test cases.

Add namespace configuration and validation, apply it to ZK metadata reads and writes, preserve the default behavior, update affected service and client code, and add unit and integration tests for default and tenant-specific namespaces.

Add username and password prompts to the Admin access flow, use a secure password-input mechanism, pass credentials only in memory, sanitize errors and logs, and add tests covering successful, failed, and omitted credential cases.
Create the maintenance branch at the appropriate baseline, verify branch/build metadata, and document the intended minor-release workflow and relationship to master.

Locate deprecated module-registry APIs and callers, remove obsolete module-definition download functions, update Shell and Admin-UI references, resolve compilation impacts, and add or adjust regression tests.

activities.activity_name: Discover random Admin port through xd-shell
activities.activity_description: Complete the direct-ZK versus load-balancer investigation, define the endpoint metadata contract, register or expose the randomly assigned Admin port in ZK, implement xd-shell discovery and connection handling, and test startup, lookup failure, and reconnect scenarios.

activities.activity_name: Update Kafka consumer integration and rerun tests
activities.activity_description: Adapt the Kafka message-bus integration to the rewritten consumer API, update test fixtures and configuration as needed, rerun previously failing tests, diagnose regressions, and add compatibility coverage for consumption, offsets, and failure handling.

activities.activity_name: Motion-JPEG ingestion feasibility spike and design
activities.activity_description: Research Motion-JPEG framing and streaming requirements, assess platform-compatible implementation options, define the stream and frame-ingestion interfaces, build a small validation prototype or test harness, document risks and constraints, and provide design recommendations for later analytics integration.
Add the servers.yml parameter with a backward-compatible default, load and validate the setting, propagate it to cluster-view services and UI behavior, and add configuration and rendering tests.

Run the complete build and relevant integration suites across Core, Admin, Shell, Admin-UI, ZK, Kafka, and cluster-view changes; fix cross-story defects, verify backward compatibility, and perform a focused security review of credential and endpoint handling.
Update configuration references, Shell/Admin usage documentation, release and maintenance-branch notes, U7 spike findings, changelog information, and final build/package verification.
